palette.scope: authored UI colors only; mandatory skins/native icons byte unchanged, text exact tokens; scene and desaturation exempt; Porter-Duff/Lanczos mixtures are derived colors
palette.method: construction provenance; no claim that photograph pixels are limited to HUD palette

every text and number traces to manifest.expected: all strings have file+key and numbers have seq/attempt evidence

all canvases color and grayscale.expected: 4 canvases per state, color plus Rec.709 gray

text contrast >=4.5.expected: >=4.5 in color and gray; no truncated text

edges contrast >=3.note: Accepted HB-08 1su skins preserved. Full sampled edge including fractional-pixel antialiasing, not ideal token-only contrast.

icons contrast >=3.expected: >=3 all opaque glyph/rim pixels in color and gray

resolved missed events.note: Series overrides obsolete уточнить criterion. No unresolved values.

primary count by frame.note: Explicit series decision wins over blanket one-primary rule

exit at 200ms FX36.expected: FX36 300ms return; card/veil gone, online chip, info toast

toast_placement.difference_reason: The bench space polygons are dilated by 15px at 1080p (10px at 720p); their top row in the toast span binds before FIELD. HB-40 VR-VS4-29 uses per-cell rectangles projected through the current camera, not these bench masks. FIELD is also protected here but does not bind this placement. The explicit CX-33 rest-hand anchor changes the rejected bottom candidate. Each chosen top is the first permitted upward step; previous pixel overlap is recorded.
